_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'me', "sex" TEXT NULL, "birth_year" INTEGER NULL, "height_cm" REAL NULL, "activity_level" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'moderate', "weight_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kg', "length_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cm', "distance_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'km', "bmi_cutoffs" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'who', "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "aliases" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "sanskrit_name" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "subcategory" TEXT NULL, "tracking_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "primary_muscles" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "secondary_muscles" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "equipment" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "difficulty" TEXT NULL, "unilateral" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("unilateral" IN (0, 1)), "mechanic" TEXT NULL, "force" TEXT NULL, "steps" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "tips" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "common_mistakes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "safety_notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "contraindications" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "met_value" REAL NULL, "default_rest_sec" INTEGER NULL, "default_hold_sec" INTEGER NULL, "variation_of" TEXT NULL, "tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_tombstones" ("exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "tracking_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "removed_in_library_version" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("exercise_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES routines (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "superset_group" INTEGER NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, "target_reps" INTEGER NULL, "target_duration_sec" INTEGER NULL, "target_distance_m" REAL NULL, "target_weight_kg" REAL NULL, "rest_sec" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "routine_id" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "perceived_effort" INTEGER NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "duration_sec" INTEGER NULL, "volume_kg" REAL NULL, "calories_kcal" REAL NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "superset_group" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "set_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal', "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL, "duration_sec" INTEGER NULL, "distance_m" REAL NULL, "rounds" INTEGER NULL, "hold_sec" INTEGER NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "is_warmup" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_warmup" IN (0, 1)), "is_pr" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_pr" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "measurement_fields" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "custom_unit" TEXT NULL, "side" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "pair_id" TEXT NULL, "body_anchor" TEXT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "built_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("built_in" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "measurement_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "measurement_values" ("entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES measurement_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "field_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entry_id", "field_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "timer_presets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "built_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("built_in" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plate_inventories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default', "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "runtime_states" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX routine_items_routine ON routine_items (routine_id)
CREATE INDEX workout_sessions_started ON workout_sessions (started_at)
CREATE INDEX session_exercises_session ON session_exercises (session_id)
CREATE INDEX session_exercises_exercise ON session_exercises (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX set_entries_session_exercise ON set_entries (session_exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX measurement_entries_date ON measurement_entries (date)
CREATE INDEX measurement_values_field ON measurement_values (field_id)
